title: Rabbi Zutra
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Berakhot 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.13b.4) in a dispute with Rabbi Yoshiyah concerning the reading of the Shema. The Gaon Shir, in [Kerem Chemed, vol. 7, p. 262](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/kOg6AQAAMAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA262), wishes to say that this is not a personal name but refers to Rabbi Yehudah Nesia, who was “junior” relative to Rabbi Yehudah HaNasi, his grandfather. Hyman rejects this, arguing that this Rabbi Zutra and Rabbi Yoshiyah were both Babylonian Tannaim who lived in Rabbi’s time, and therefore they are mentioned in a baraita.

notes.text: [Hyman’s printed notice](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3f/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._I._1910.pdf#page=413) gives ש״ז. The supplied Hebrew has ש״ן. The linked page of Kerem Chemed and its [continuation on p. 263](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/kOg6AQAAMAAJ?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=PA263) contain Rapoport’s discussion of “Zutra,” including the proposal that it describes Judah Nesia as junior to his grandfather.

The linked Gemara names Rav Zutra and Rabbi Yoshiyah in a baraita about the Shema. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1091&lang=en) gives Rabbi Zutra under that name, while Hyman argues against Rapoport’s identification.
